basis: The August 25 earnings release first established the threshold through actual results. For the 13 weeks ended July 30, 2022, consolidated GAAP net sales were $805,091,000 versus $864,850,000 for the 13 weeks ended July 31, 2021. Reported sales declined 6.91% and were $16,516,500 below the $821,607,500 cutoff. The release separately reported a 4% constant-currency decline.

coverage.detail: March 2, preceding earnings cycle. The FY2021 Q4 release projected FY2022 sales growth of 2% to 4% and a low-single-digit increase for Q1. Neither forecast established a Q2 sales ceiling.
March 2 earnings call. The CFO gave sales guidance for FY2022 and Q1, with no qualifying Q2 forecast.

May 24, previous quarterly release. Management explicitly projected a low-single-digit Q2 net sales decline from approximately $865 million. That outlook allowed a decline smaller than 5%. The two roughly 300-basis-point headwinds were inputs already reflected in the forecast.
May 24 earnings call. Management repeated the low-single-digit Q2 sales decline outlook.
May 24 investor presentation. Slide 28 revised full-year net sales guidance to flat through 2% growth. It supplied no tighter Q2 bound.
June 9 Form 8-K covered governance, compensation and shareholder voting.
June 14 Investor Day release. The $4.1 billion to $4.3 billion revenue target applied to annual revenue by fiscal 2025.
June 14 Investor Day slides presented the fiscal 2025 plan and longer-term targets. They supplied no qualifying FY2022 Q2 sales forecast.

June 14 public Investor Day remarks, furnished June 22. Investor relations expressly said the company would refrain from commenting on intra-quarter trends because much of Q2, including back-to-school, remained ahead.
August 1 issuer release announced a director’s departure and gave no sales update.
August 5 issuer notice scheduled the August 25 results call and gave no preliminary sales figure.
August 25 at 7:30 a.m. ET. The issuer publicly distributed the results, including the consolidated net sales table in thousands of dollars.

August 25 at 8:30 a.m. ET. Management confirmed the release had gone out earlier that morning and described the actual sales decline as a miss against the low-single-digit decline forecast on the Q1 call.

publication_date_evidence: The SEC-hosted earnings release is datelined August 25, 2022. The issuer’s original wire distribution records 7:30 a.m. ET that day, before the earnings call, the August 29 Form 8-K and the September 7 Form 10-Q.
